|lore=Overcrowding in heavy fire zones increases chances of accidentally shooting one's own comrades. Stormtroopers never let accuracy get in the way of victory.
|game_text=An accident occurs at the beginning of a battle at any site where opponent has at least two characters and one weapon. Draw destiny. If destiny &lt; number of opponent's characters at that site, one is lost. (Opponent's choice.)
